generic.failed: That didn't work. Please try again.
generic.server: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again in a moment.
generic.not_found: This isn't here any more, or you can't open it.

network.offline: You seem to be offline. Check your connection and try again.

http.too_large: That is too large to send.
http.error: That didn't work. Please try again.

validation.json_invalid: That didn't arrive correctly. Please try again.

auth.csrf: Your session needs a refresh. Reload the page and try again.
auth.forbidden: You don't have access to this.
auth.wrong_credentials: That email and password don't match.
auth.locked: Too many tries. Wait {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}} and try again.
auth.disabled: This account is turned off. Ask your institution for help.
auth.reset_invalid: This reset link has expired or was already used. Ask for a new one.
auth.domain_not_allowed: Sign-up needs an email address from your institution.
auth.email_taken: There is already an account with this email. Try signing in.
auth.code_wrong: That code isn't right. {left, plural, one {# try left} other {# tries left}}.
auth.code_expired: That code has expired. Start again to get a new one.
auth.too_many_codes: Too many codes asked for. Wait a while and try again.

user.cannot_change_self: You can't change your own role or turn off your own account.

program.name_taken: There is already a program with this name.
program.pattern_invalid: Pick how the program is divided.
program.terms_do_not_fit: This program has terms beyond {max}. Remove them first.

course.not_editable: Only the course owner or an admin can change this.
course.no_classmates: You need to be placed in a program to share with classmates.
course.not_catalog: This works for school courses only.
course.owner_must_be_faculty: The owner must be a faculty member.
course.personal_limit: You have reached {max} personal courses. Archive one to make room.

archive.parent_archived: Restore the program, term or course this belongs to first.

order.mismatch: The list changed while you were working. It has been refreshed — try again.

topic.move_within_course: Topics can only move within their course.

upload.not_an_image: That file isn't an image we can show (PNG, JPEG, GIF or WebP).
upload.too_large: Files can be up to {max_mb} MB.
upload.use_uploaded_image: Upload the image here instead of linking to it.

quiz.empty: This quiz has no questions yet.
quiz.answer_every_question: Answer every question before you submit.
quiz.answer_invalid: That answer isn't one of the choices.
quiz.answers_after_submit: Answers are shown after you submit.
quiz.not_editable: This quiz can't be changed here.
quiz.too_many_questions: A test can have up to {max} questions.

question.topic_outside: Question {number} points to a topic outside this course.

practice.no_material: This topic has no text to make questions from yet.

review.nothing_due: Nothing is due for review. Nice work!
review.no_questions: There are no questions to review yet. Take a quick check on a topic first.

bank.duplicate: This question is already in the bank.
bank.not_yours: Only the person who saved this question can change it.

import.too_large: Files can be up to {max_mb} MB.
import.too_many_rows: Up to {max} rows at a time.
import.duplicate_row: This row repeats an earlier one.
import.answer_empty: Choice {letter} is empty but later choices are filled.
import.correct_invalid: The correct answer must be a letter from A to {last}.
import.topic_unknown: No topic called “{topic}” — the question will have no topic.
import.topic_ambiguous: More than one topic is called “{topic}” — the question will have no topic.

studio.too_much_material: That's more material than one course can hold. Split it into two courses.
studio.file_type: Use a PDF, a Word file (.docx) or a text file.

studio.word_unreadable: This Word file couldn't be read.
studio.pdf_unreadable: This PDF couldn't be read. It may be locked or damaged.
studio.pdf_no_text: This PDF is scanned pages with no text in it. Paste the text instead.
studio.no_outline: Split the material into topics first.
studio.outline_invalid: The outline doesn't look right. Split it again.
studio.outline_order: Topics must follow the material's order without overlapping.
studio.range_invalid: Those paragraphs aren't in the material.
studio.source_not_found: That file isn't in the material any more.
studio.would_replace: This course already has topics. Choose to replace them.

ai.unavailable: The AI helper isn't set up here yet.
ai.needs_own_key: Add your AI key in your profile to use the AI helper.
ai.limit_reached: You've used today's {limit} AI requests. They refresh within a day.
ai.provider_error: The AI helper isn't answering right now. Try again in a moment.
ai.key_refused: Your AI key was refused. Check it in your profile.
ai.bad_answer: The AI helper gave an answer we couldn't use. Try again.
ai.key_not_needed: Your institution provides the AI helper — you don't need a key.
